repositories.one_line_purpose: A stateless thermal specification model for computing cooling requirements and margins.
repositories.innovation: The Alpha strand isolates physical calculations and immutable thermal evidence from controller behavior.
repositories.evolution: It evolved as the computational half of a paired thermal-control helix.

evidence.label: Thermal specification
evidence.claim: Computes cooling demand and thermal margins.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A stateful flow controller that acts on thermal requirements produced by the Alpha strand.
repositories.innovation: The Omega strand makes actuation, feedback, and control-state transitions independently reviewable.
repositories.evolution: It evolved as the operational half of a paired thermal-control helix.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A stateless power-budget model for compute and infrastructure demand.
repositories.innovation: It produces explicit energy requirements and reserve margins without mixing them with runtime shedding policy.
repositories.evolution: It evolved as the computational half of a paired energy-management helix.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A stateful load-shedding controller that protects critical workloads under constrained power.
repositories.innovation: It turns power shortfall into an ordered, inspectable control response rather than an undifferentiated shutdown.
repositories.evolution: It evolved as the operational half of a paired energy-management helix.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A rack-planning model for assigning compute capacity under infrastructure constraints.
repositories.innovation: It makes rack placement and capacity decisions visible as data instead of burying them in deployment scripts.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into a compute-capacity provider for the cooling and energy strands.
